title: [Improvement] Bolus advisor : remove alert if we enter carbs before the alert occurs...
body:
Bolus advisor works well, but it could take a very long time before alert occurs (if very high and difficulties to decrease BG value).
=> For lunch I activated Bolus advisor (at about 12:15), but I finally ate (and entered carbs) at 12:45 (meeting at 13:00!), without Bolus Advisor alert. 
It's much later (at about 17:00) that I finally received the alert that it was time to eat... (Yes I know, it's a bad day for bg values...)

It would be cool if we had the possibility, when we enter carbs after activating Bolus Advisor, to automatically remove the Bolus Advisor alert (or be able to remove it manually)...
